title: Clean Heart, Clean Path
truth: God's Word helps us live a pure life because Jesus cleanses our hearts.
points: Jesus makes our hearts clean and new.
Reading the Bible shows us how to live.
God's Word helps us choose good things.
apply: Think of one thing you can do to follow Jesus's example, like being kind to someone or helping out at home. Ask God to show you.
prayer: God, thank You for sending Jesus to make our hearts pure, and for giving us Your Word to guide us.
